breakdownProperty.description: Breakdown property the color is scoped to, so the color applies only to tiles that break down by that property. Omit to apply it under every property.

breakdownType.description: Breakdown type the value came from, such as `event`, `person`, `session`, or `cohort`.

breakdownValue.description: The breakdown value this color applies to, as it appears in the chart legend.

colorToken.description: Palette slot to color the value with, as `preset-1` upwards. Not a CSS color: a hex value is rejected. Null leaves the value on its default color.

source.description:
`manual` for a color a person picked, `auto` for one the dashboard assigned.

* `auto` - auto
* `manual` - manual

breakdown_colors.description: Colors pinned to specific breakdown values across the dashboard's tiles. A list of entries, not an object keyed by breakdown value. Send an empty list to clear them.

data_color_theme_id.description: ID of the color theme used for chart visualizations.

delete_insights.description: When deleting, also delete insights that are only on this dashboard.

grid_spacing.description:
Named tile density preset. Use tight, condensed, standard, relaxed, or wide.

* `tight` - tight
* `condensed` - condensed
* `standard` - standard
* `relaxed` - relaxed
* `wide` - wide

direction.description:
Where the copies go. vertical stacks each copy below the one before it. horizontal puts the copies side by side, and starts a new row when the grid is full.

* `vertical` - vertical
* `horizontal` - horizontal

variable.description: Name of the metric dashboard variable, without the $. Each copy of the group gets one of its values.

group_repeats.description: Tile groups to repeat, keyed by the tiles' group_key. The dashboard shows one copy of each insight tile in the group for each selected value of the metric variable, with the variable set to that value. Edit mode shows only the original tiles. A write replaces the whole map. Send an empty object or null to stop all repeats.

group_titles.description: Titles for tile groups, keyed by the tiles' group_key. The dashboard shows a title above its group. A write replaces the whole map. Send an empty object or null to remove all group titles.

include_dashboards.description: Opt in to receiving the deprecated `dashboards` field in insight payloads. Once opt-in enforcement is enabled, API-token callers stop receiving it by default; use `dashboard_tiles` instead.

layout_compaction.description:
How tiles rearrange after a move or resize. vertical stacks tiles upward, horizontal stacks tiles to the left, and stable preserves positions while moving colliding tiles.

* `vertical` - vertical
* `horizontal` - horizontal
* `stable` - stable

quick_filter_ids.description: List of quick filter IDs associated with this dashboard

use_dashboard.description: ID of an existing dashboard to duplicate.

use_template.description: Template key to create the dashboard from a predefined template.
